brief: Complete the work order WO-3182 for the cooling controller, repair the active seepage at the lower gasket face, and service the louvre dampers that are stiff and not opening fully on the thermostat call [SOP-016]. Clear any stored material or obstructions from the ventilation openings and radiator bank [SOP-011]. Since the unit is 35 years old and insulation ageing is cumulative and irreversible, verify all forced cooling equipment is fully operational before the heat event [MG-023, SOP-016].
